units: Ib. 134ᵇ (ref. to Deut. XVIII, 3) להביא חלב שע״ג הק׳ וכ׳ this (הַ) serves to include the fat surrounding and inside the maw; a. e.—Esp. rennet, used to curdle milk.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:5">Ab. Zar. II, 5</cite> <he>קֵיבַת נבלה</he>, <he>קיבה של נ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00859"><he>עָמַד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:5">Ib.</cite> <he>קיבת עולה</he> rennet of a burnt-offering.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:1:8">Y. Bets. I, 60ᵃ</cite> <he>קיבת הגוי</he> rennet supplied by a gentile.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:1:8">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>ק׳ ממקום אחר באת</he> the rennet in the maw comes from outside (is not considered a part of the animal itself); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="S00045"><he>קֵבוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00030"><he>קֵי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:1:8">Ib.</cite> <he>התירו קֵיבוֹתֵיהֶם</he> they allowed to use the rennets of these sheep; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:7:3">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᶜ</cite> bot.
